description: List, read, save (create or update), delete document presets, or save the active document's setup as a preset (File > Document Presets > Define)

action.description: list every preset; get one; save creates or updates one from settings; delete one; save_from_document stores the active document's page size, pages, columns, margins, bleed and slug

margin.description: One margin for all four sides, mm ("Make all settings the same"); not together with top/bottom/left/right

name.description: Preset name (for get, save, delete and save_from_document)

settings.description: New Document / Document Preset settings, by object-model name (DocumentPreset); measurements in mm

createPrimaryTextFrame.description: Primary Text Frame on the parent page

documentBleedUniformSize.description: Use the same bleed on every side

documentSlugUniformSize.description: Use the same slug on every side

intent.description: Intent: the Print / Web / Mobile preset category

left.description: Left (inside, with facing pages) margin, mm

right.description: Right (outside, with facing pages) margin, mm

name: manage_document_presets
title: Manage Document Presets
